description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling legacy 'submission' endpoints which are deprecated in favor of 'data-assets'. It includes routes to create, retrieve, validate, and approve submissions, and adds deprecation warnings in responses. The file relies on external services for data management, validation, approval, and authentication, and serves as a backward compatibility layer within a larger API project.

methods.name: JSONResponse add_deprecation_header(response: JSONResponse)
methods.description: Adds HTTP headers to indicate API deprecation to clients.

methods.name: create_submission( payload: Dict[str, Any], current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles creation of a submission, mapping to legacy data asset creation, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: get_submission( submission_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a submission, mapped from data asset retrieval, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Triggers validation of a submission, forwarding to validation service, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of a submission, involving signature validation and SoD checks, with deprecation warning.
